text:
Rae Kim: Quick sync — proposing we move to stable resource paths + query params for panel/drawer state and introduce a compact breadcrumb strip. Regroup left nav to Workspaces / Models / Deployments / Observability / Billing. Breadcrumb UI: single-line compact row above header, truncated crumbs with aria-labels, a small copy-permalink affordance that returns a server-canonicalized permalink. Also a mobile pill (shows short path, long-press to copy) that opens a bottom sheet with full path. :sparkles:

Diego M.: Agree on stable path + params. Engineering concerns: history churn — we should coalesce quick UI toggles via replaceState and only pushState for user-intent navigations. Also recommend a server endpoint to return canonicalized permalinks (POST /permalinks/canonicalize) so client doesn't accidentally expose transient flags.

Harper L.: A11y notes: announce location changes with an aria-live polite region that prepends "Current location:" (eg. "Current location: Workspace ACME, Models, model-xyz, revision 3"). Skip-link must land on the active main region (id="main-panel-current"). Breadcrumbs must be tabbable and keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space). Last crumb needs aria-current="page" and each crumb should have an accessible name that reads full path.

Olivia P.: Microcopy + UX: truncate visible crumb text but provide full-text tooltip and an explicit "Copy link" action in tooltip. When copy runs show a toast: "Copied canonical link" with a small permalink preview. On mobile the pill shows something like "ACME · Models · model-xyz…"; tapping opens sheet with full path and a Copy button. Add analytics: breadcrumb_navigate, breadcrumb_copy, permalink_open.

Rae Kim: Example canonical URLs for spec: ```https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=metrics&metric=latency&range=24h``` and ```https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models/model-xyz?revision=42``` Shareable params = panel, metric, range, revision. Non-shareable = dev flags, ui_debug.

Diego M.: Implementation checklist suggestion: router middleware for canonicalization (server strips ephemeral params), param whitelist, history manager (push vs replace rules), copy-permalink API that returns canonical URL. I'll prototype middleware and a small demo of history coalescing.

Harper L.: Keyboard specifics: breadcrumbs are inside <nav aria-label="Breadcrumbs">, crumbs are links/buttons, Enter triggers navigation but focus should not move automatically — only move focus if navigation lands on a different primary panel. Tooltips must be accessible (aria-describedby) and not rely only on hover. Live region text should be concise and consistent for e2e tests.

Olivia P.: Visual: chevrons + truncation, tooltip shows full id in monospace with inline copy icon. For extremely long ids show a copy-only control. We'll include a small preview in the copy toast. Figma mock incoming: <https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/breadcrumb-pill> :art:

NavBot: Reminder: run automated a11y checks and keyboard-only flows. Pinned checklist: focus order, aria-current, live-region phrasing, skip-link target, copy-link server canonicalization.

Rae Kim: Owners/action items: Diego - spike router middleware + copy-permalink API (due Mon), Harper - produce aria-live copy + e2e keyboard tests (due Tue), Olivia - Figma mocks for desktop strip + mobile pill + copy toast copy variants (due Wed). Can we target a small pilot on a staging workspace next sprint?

Diego M.: :thumbsup: Will open RFC in eng-platform and add prototype code samples.

Harper L.: I'll add the accessibility acceptance criteria to the PR template and schedule a quick review.

Olivia P.: Will post Figma links and three microcopy options here when ready.

NavBot: Pinned: "NAV-221: Breadcrumb + Permalink pilot checklist" and scheduled review meeting next Thu.
